problem.patternRequired: Daily notes have no file name pattern. Set one in Workspace Settings.
problem.invalidPath: The daily notes folder, file name pattern, or template isn't a valid path. Fix it in Workspace Settings.
problem.hiddenPath: The daily notes folder or file name pattern starts a name with a dot, and notes can't be created in a hidden folder or file. Fix it in Workspace Settings.

settings.title: Daily Notes
settings.description: Where Open Today's Note keeps each day's note. Saved to .glyph/config.json, so it travels with the folder.

folder.label: Folder
folder.hint: workspace-relative; empty for the workspace root

filenamePattern.label: File name pattern
filenamePattern.hint: YYYY, YY, MM, M, DD, and D are replaced by today's date; [text] in brackets is kept as written

template.label: Template file
template.hint: workspace-relative; copied into each new note

errors.invalidPath: The folder, file name pattern, and template can't contain ".." or any of < > : " | ? *
errors.hiddenPath: The folder and file name pattern can't start a name with a dot: notes can't be created in a hidden folder or file.
